method: Paired real native-model discovery sessions on copies of original wave-32 apps, using the exact wave-33 day-two briefs/backend instructions, ending at an implementation/proof plan. No app implementation, deploy, production accounts, frontend build or full day-two score. Same model CLIs/flags as run-bakeoff.mjs. Docs are o200k_base tokens from actual tool-visible package/guide/init outputs; Echo-delimited compound command output is attributed to its producing command; app source/check outputs are excluded when unambiguously separated. Guide/init/help/package reads are counted as documentation (wave33 docs category, with day2 handover included). Automatic runtime-change notes from check are separately measured as check ceremony, matching wave33 tx/agg.py; docsPlusAutomaticChangeNotes also exposes the stricter all-instructional-text total. Unmatched batches remain conservative; docsAndBatchedSourceUpperBound retains the original whole-batch count. Raw CLI stdout is an independent cross-check, not substituted for tool-visible bytes. Native total/cached/uncached input, calls and wall include provider waits and concurrent host load.
baseline: Retained original 0.4.44 client/platform tarballs from ~/sb4-loop/dist/0.4.44; after uses installed candidate tarballs. README/card/digest bytes and artifact hashes are recorded. Whole-wave input means are contextual and not paired full-app comparisons.
